skills.name: mtn-momo-integration
skills.description: Builds and reviews direct integrations with the MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) Open API from momodeveloper.mtn.com, including Collection request-to-pay, Disbursement transfers and refunds, API user and access token handling, X-Reference-Id idempotency, unsigned callbacks confirmed by status checks, and sandbox testing for MTN markets such as Ghana, Uganda and Cameroon. Use when integrating MTN MoMo directly rather than through Paystack or another aggregator, calling requesttopay or disbursement endpoints, handling MoMo callbacks, or debugging MoMo API errors such as 401, 409 or INVALID_CALLBACK_URL_HOST.

skills.name: paystack-integration
skills.description: Builds and reviews Paystack payment integrations, including transaction initialisation, server-side verification, webhooks with HMAC-SHA512 signature checks, idempotent fulfilment, and Ghana mobile money (MTN, Telecel, AT) charges. Use when adding Paystack checkout, card or mobile money payments, handling Paystack webhooks, or debugging a Paystack payment flow.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Security review of a code change or module covering secrets, injection, authentication and authorization, input validation, data exposure, dependencies and unsafe configuration, with findings ranked by severity and concrete fixes. Use when the user asks for a security review, audit or vulnerability check, or before shipping code that handles auth, payments, user input, files or personal data.

skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.description: Creates or improves an Agent Skill (a SKILL.md folder) so it loads reliably and works unchanged in Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and Kete Code, including portable frontmatter, a tight trigger description, short instructions, helper scripts and trigger evals. Use when the user wants to write a new skill, turn a repeated workflow into a skill, or fix a skill that triggers at the wrong time.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.description: Test-first development loop that writes a failing test, makes it pass with the smallest change, then refactors with the suite green. Use when adding a feature, fixing a reproducible bug, or refactoring code in a project that has (or should have) automated tests.

skills.name: verification-loop
skills.description: Pre-merge verification that detects the project's build, lint, type-check and test commands, runs them in order, fixes what it safely can and reports a pass/fail verdict. Use when the user asks to verify, check or validate changes before committing, opening a pull request, merging or shipping.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a diff or branch for correctness bugs in a separate context and returns a short, verified list of findings ranked by severity, without editing any files. Use when the user asks for a code review of their changes, a second pair of eyes before a commit or pull request, or a check of whether a change breaks existing callers.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify the current changes by running the project's build, lint, type-check and tests, then report pass or fail.
